summary.text: Polly Elbertse is the Democratic candidate for South Carolina House of Representatives District 20 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Stephen Frank (R).
A dental hygienist, she says she is focused on health care and education.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, Polly Elbertse earned a bachelor's degree from Wake Forest University and has worked as a dental hygienist.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as the mother of two girls who works as a dental hygienist in a pediatric dental office.
Elbertse said in the survey that the legislature should enact policies that improve quality of life for all South Carolinians, especially the most vulnerable.

Her stated priorities include making health care more accessible and billing more transparent, investing in public education, stewardship of natural resources and incentivizing sustainable economic development.
